source_model: P21E raport 064, P21D raport 060, P20D geometry
geometry_status: Neumann rectangular empty-cavity surrogate. Braces, sealed inserts, porosity, irregular solid basket omitted. Nominal air volume only modifies zero-mode compressibility; geometric width/depth/height are from rectangular P20D gross cavity.
electrical_drive: 1 V RMS harmonic, not SPL/THD or DSP
scope: Passive reciprocal Galerkin model, 3D Neumann rectangular acoustic modes and 1-3 compliant wall pistons. Not actual P21D obstacles, foam, FEM, real product parameters or measurements. Panel damping and shape assumed.
